# ExCrop — China Fresh Garlic Exporter

> ExCrop (Heneng International Trade Group (Shandong) Co., Ltd.) is a garlic export company based in Shandong, China. We supply Normal White garlic, Pure White garlic and Dehydrated Garlic Flakes to importers, wholesalers and distributors worldwide. MOQ: 1 x 40HQ reefer container (28 MT). Cold chain: -2°C to -3°C. Direct factory pricing from Shandong growing region, 500 km from Qingdao Port.

Primary contact: WhatsApp +86 136 5898 0612 · Email contact@excrop.com · Website https://excrop.com

## Products

- [Normal White Garlic](https://excrop.com/products/normal-white-garlic): Main volume product, sizes 4.5-6.5cm, mesh bags 10kg/20kg
- [Pure White Garlic](https://excrop.com/products/pure-white-garlic): Premium grade, sizes 5.0-6.5cm, carton packing 10kg
- [Dehydrated Garlic Flakes](https://excrop.com/products/dehydrated-garlic-flakes): Food processing grade dried garlic flakes

## Company Facts (verified)

- Company name: Heneng International Trade Group (Shandong) Co., Ltd. (brand: ExCrop)
- Origin: Shandong Province, China (major garlic growing region)
- Port of loading: Qingdao Port, China
- Annual supply capacity: year-round, including cold-stored garlic
- Products: Normal White garlic, Pure White garlic, Dehydrated Garlic Flakes
- Sizes: 4.5cm, 5.0cm, 5.5cm, 6.0cm, 6.5cm+
- Packing: 10kg/20kg mesh bags, 10kg cartons, or customized
- MOQ: 1 x 40HQ reefer container (approx. 28 MT)
- Shipping: reefer containers at -2°C to -3°C
- Payment: T/T, L/C at sight
